dataset_name: NSIDC Sea Ice Index v4 (G02135) Southern Hemisphere daily sea-ice extent
steps: Read 15865 data rows; second header row gives units {'Year': 'YYYY', 'Month': 'MM', 'Day': 'DD', 'Extent': '10^6 sq km', 'Missing': '10^6 sq km', 'Source Data': 'Source data product web sites: http://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0081.html and http://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0051.html'}

units_row.Source Data: Source data product web sites: http://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0081.html and http://nsidc.org/data/nsidc-0051.html

issues.detail: Gaps > 2 days (the record is every-other-day before 1987-08; the 1987-12-03..1988-01-12 SSM/I outage is a known gap)
Days where the product reports non-zero missing area (retained, flagged)

outputs.description: Daily Southern Hemisphere extent with ISO dates and missing-area flag

notes: Downloaded by this pipeline from the official NSIDC HTTPS archive (see provenance JSON); not part of DATAS/.
